content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm searching for a pH sensor that can be connected to [product_name]. Finding a suitable option has been challenging. I did notice an Arduino project where they converted a BNC connector to a wired connection. [url] Do you think this could work with [product_name] [version_no]?

The sensor operates with a 5 VDC supply and provides a 0-4 VDC output. [product_name] analog inputs accept signals from 0 to 10 V, so you would only utilize 400 of 1000 possible input units. As a result, there may be considerable error at the lower end of the input range.
Thank you for your response. Is it possible to use the Ethernet port instead, by converting BNC to Ethernet? [url] I'd like to use the same pH sensor as before. [url]
I don't believe this converter supports communication using the [product_name] protocol over Ethernet TCP/IP.
Are there any recommendations for reading pH values with [product_name] [version_no]? Would any sensor that outputs 4-20mA be compatible?

Yes, that's possible. If you wish to read a current signal directly, an analog expansion module like AM2 is needed, unless your device already has analog inputs. If your [product_name] lacks analog inputs, you'll require an AM2 module. If analog inputs (0-10V) are available and you have a free one, you can convert a current signal to a voltage reading using a 500 Ohm resistor.

I have [product_name] [version_no] with built-in analog inputs (0-10V), plus an additional analog expansion module. Thank you for your assistance. It seems I've found a suitable sensor: [url]. Hoping it will work as intended.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is exploring ways to connect a pH sensor with a BNC connector to [product_name] [version_no], facing challenges with signal compatibility and connectivity. There is uncertainty regarding analog versus Ethernet interfaces and which sensors or modules will offer reliable readings. Community replies highlighted signal matching issues, necessary expansion modules, and voltage/current conversion methods.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks to accurately read pH measurements from a sensor via the available analog or Ethernet ports of [product_name] [version_no], and is looking for recommendations on sensor compatibility and required hardware for proper integration.
